integrity.claim_scope: Exact finite-sample theorem with a rational-arithmetic certificate and explicit extremizer.
integrity.literature_statement: Novelty is limited to the exact four-variable small-level formula and extremizer; the general pairwise-moment LP methodology is prior art.

scientific_limitations: The exact formula is established only for \(0\leq\alpha\leq2/5\).
Historical literature phrased as general finite moment or Bonferroni extremal problems remains a residual originality risk.
No result is claimed for power, alternatives, more than four hypotheses, or false-discovery-rate control beyond the global null.
title: Sharp small-level Simes size for four pairwise-independent p-values
